selected_problem: Fresh-main inspection found that ChangesetStore.stage accepted an existing directory as a write/delete target. Apply preflight only compared existence and sha256, so a multi-file changeset could mutate earlier regular files and then fail on the directory with DELETE_FILE_ONLY or a filesystem rename/write error, violating the reversible delivery boundary even though the unsupported target was deterministically knowable at stage time.

decision_provenance.claim_limit: No hosted DWAC success receipt is claimed. The committed DWAC North Star and four-mode router contracts were replayed against fresh canonical code evidence after the hosted Developer Execution Runtime returned transient HTTP 502.

pre_fix_reproduction.summary: The fresh-main implementation staged a multi-file changeset containing a directory target instead of rejecting it; the new regression expectation failed with Missing expected exception.

changes: ChangesetStore.stage now fails closed when an existing target is not a regular file.
The unsupported target is rejected before any changeset document is persisted or any later apply can begin.
Existing canonical path, preimage, apply-preflight and rollback-preflight semantics remain unchanged.
truthfulness_boundary: This closes the deterministically knowable existing-directory target case at stage time. It does not claim crash-level filesystem atomicity for arbitrary I/O failures, nor does it claim general native semantic synthesis for arbitrary repositories is solved.
